<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Dailey Demolition | The App by Kate Dailey</title>
<meta name="description" content="Workouts, nutrition, food logging, habits and cycle tracking in one app. Built by Kate Dailey for women who want to get strong.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0d1452;
  --navy-2:#1a2a8c;
  --navy-3:#2b3fc0;
  --ink:#0b1130;
  --muted:#6b7088;
  --lav:#eef0fd;
  --lav-2:#e2e5fb;
  --surface:#f6f7fa;
  --line:#e7e9f0;
  --sky:#b9cdea;
  --studio:#c3d2d3;
  --green:#22c55e;
  --r:28px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;overflow-x:clip}
body{font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display',system-ui,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
h1,h2,h3,h4{letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:800;line-height:1;color:var(--navy)}
.h2{font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,76px)}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--lav);color:var(--navy);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px}
.pill b{color:var(--navy-3)}
.pill i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy-3);animation:ping 2s infinite}
@keyframes ping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(43,63,192,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(43,63,192,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(43,63,192,0)}}
.lede{font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted)}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-3) 40%,#7d9bd8 60%,var(--navy) 100%);background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:shine 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes shine{0%,100%{background-position:0% 0}50%{background-position:100% 0}}

/* buttons */
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:18px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;transition:color .35s,box-shadow .3s,transform .2s;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;border-radius:inherit;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.btn:hover:before{transform:scale(1.5)}
.btn .arr{display:inline-block;transition:transform .35s}
.btn:hover .arr{transform:translateX(4px)}
.btn-n{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(13,20,82,.6)}
.btn-n:before{background:var(--navy-3)}
.btn-n:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 40px -14px rgba(43,63,192,.7)}
.btn-o{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line)}
.btn-o:before{background:var(--lav)}
.btn-w{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.btn-w:before{background:var(--lav-2)}

/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:60;padding:18px 0;transition:all .35s}
nav.s{padding:10px 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
nav .logo img{height:42px}
nav .links{display:flex;gap:4px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:999px;padding:5px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
nav .links a{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted);transition:all .25s}
nav .links a:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 4px 12px -6px rgba(13,20,82,.25)}
nav .btn{padding:13px 22px;font-size:14px}

/* blobs (moving background) */
.blobs{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0,#000 22%,#000 78%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0,#000 22%,#000 78%,transparent 100%)}
.hero .blobs{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0,#000 70%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0,#000 70%,transparent 100%)}
.pcard .blobs{-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}
.blobs b{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px)}
.blobs b:nth-child(1){width:560px;height:560px;background:#dfe5fd;left:-12%;top:-10%;animation:d1 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.blobs b:nth-child(2){width:520px;height:520px;background:#cfe0f3;right:-10%;top:20%;animation:d2 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.blobs b:nth-child(3){width:420px;height:420px;background:#e9e4fb;left:30%;bottom:-25%;animation:d1 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
@keyframes d1{to{transform:translate(25%,20%) scale(1.15)}}
@keyframes d2{to{transform:translate(-30%,-15%) scale(.9)}}
.dark .blobs b:nth-child(1){background:#1f2f9e;opacity:.6}
.dark .blobs b:nth-child(2){background:#3a5bd0;opacity:.35}
.dark .blobs b:nth-child(3){background:#6a7fd6;opacity:.3}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.05fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;padding-top:110px;padding-bottom:60px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(50px,min(7.2vw,calc((100vh - 420px) / 2.1)),112px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:.93;margin:0 0 24px}
.hero h1 .ln{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.06em}
.hero h1 .ln span{display:block;transform:translateY(110%);animation:up 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards}
.hero h1 .ln:nth-child(2) span{animation-delay:.12s}
@keyframes up{to{transform:none}}
.hero .sub{opacity:0;animation:fade 1s .5s forwards}
.hero p{max-width:470px;margin-bottom:32px}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .avail{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .avail span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.hero .avail svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:var(--navy)}
@keyframes fade{to{opacity:1}}
.stage{position:relative;height:min(680px,calc(100vh - 140px));min-height:500px;opacity:0;animation:fade 1.2s .3s forwards}
.stage .photo{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 4%;background-size:cover;background-position:30% 40%;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side at 48% 50%,#000 62%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side at 48% 50%,#000 62%,transparent 100%);animation:kb 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes kb{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.08) translate(-1%,1%)}}
.stage .ph1{position:absolute;right:2%;top:4%;z-index:3}
.stage .ph1 .phone{width:min(250px,calc((100vh - 220px) * .4))}
.card-f{position:absolute;z-index:4;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-radius:20px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -20px rgba(13,20,82,.35),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap}
.card-f small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:2px}
.card-f .ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:16px;flex:0 0 auto}
.card-f .ic.l{background:var(--lav);color:var(--navy)}
.card-f.c1{left:0;top:16%}
.card-f.c2{left:8%;bottom:10%}
.card-f.c3{right:0;bottom:4%}
.ring{width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 auto}
.ring circle{fill:none;stroke-width:5}
.ring .bg{stroke:#e6e8f2}
.ring .fg{stroke:var(--navy);stroke-linecap:round;transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:center;stroke-dasharray:113;stroke-dashoffset:113;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.in .ring .fg,.hero .ring .fg.go{stroke-dashoffset:var(--o)}
.float{animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.float.b{animation-delay:-2s}.float.c{animation-delay:-4s}
@keyframes fl{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -12px}}

/* phone */
.phone{width:280px;aspect-ratio:9/19.4;border-radius:46px;padding:10px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#e9ebf2,#b9bdcc 40%,#8a8fa3);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 40px 80px -30px rgba(13,20,82,.45),0 18px 30px -18px rgba(13,20,82,.3);position:relative}
.phone:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:86px;height:25px;border-radius:20px;background:#0b0c12;z-index:3}
.phone .scr{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:37px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #0b0c12}
.phone .scr img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 0;padding-top:38px;background:#fff}
.phone .scr img.long{animation:pan 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes pan{0%,10%{object-position:50% 0}90%,100%{object-position:50% 100%}}

/* ticker */
.ticker{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;padding:22px 0;position:relative;z-index:3}
.ticker .t{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:mq 38s linear infinite}
.ticker span{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;padding:0 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:52px;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker span:after{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sky)}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* statement */
.statement{position:relative;padding:150px 0 120px;overflow:hidden}
.statement .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.statement p.big{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,64px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.1;max-width:1100px;color:var(--navy)}
.statement p.big span{opacity:.18;transition:opacity .15s}
.statement p.big span.on{opacity:1}
.statement p.big .hl{color:var(--navy-3)}
.statement .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:30px;margin-top:56px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.statement .row p{max-width:420px}

/* inside */
.inside{padding:40px 0 100px}
.inside .head{text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 10px}
.inside .head h2{margin:18px 0 16px}
.sticky{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px}
.phonecol{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.phonecol .panel{position:absolute;inset:12% 4%;border-radius:40px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--lav),#dde6f6);overflow:hidden}
.phonecol .panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:140%;aspect-ratio:1;left:-20%;top:-20%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent,rgba(43,63,192,.14),transparent 30%);animation:spin 10s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.phonecol .phone{width:min(300px,calc((100vh - 160px) * .46));z-index:2}
.phonecol .phone .scr img{opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s}
.phonecol .phone .scr img.act{opacity:1}
.pip{position:absolute;z-index:3;transition:opacity .3s,transform .4s}
.pip.p1{left:0;top:24%}
.pip.p2{right:0;bottom:22%}
.steps{padding:6vh 0}
.fstep{min-height:66vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;opacity:.25;transition:opacity .5s}
.fstep.act{opacity:1}
.fstep .pill{align-self:flex-start}
.fstep h3{font-size:clamp(38px,4.4vw,62px);margin:18px 0 18px}
.fstep p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;max-width:460px;margin-bottom:24px}
.fstep ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;max-width:500px}
.fstep li{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);color:var(--navy);transition:all .25s;cursor:default}
.fstep li:hover{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:none;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.fstep .mph{display:none}
.swipehint{display:none}

/* carousel */
.carousel{padding:130px 0;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,var(--surface) 22%,var(--surface) 78%,#fff 100%);position:relative}
.carousel .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:50px}
.carousel .top p{max-width:360px}
.belt{display:flex;gap:30px;width:max-content;animation:mq 60s linear infinite;padding:30px 0}
.carousel:hover .belt{animation-play-state:paused}
.belt .item{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.belt .item:nth-child(odd){transform:translateY(28px)}
.belt .item:hover{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(1.04)}
.belt .phone{width:240px}
.belt .cap{text-align:center;margin-top:20px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy)}

/* bento */
.bento{padding:120px 0}
.bento .head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:46px}
.bento .head p{max-width:380px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-auto-rows:230px;gap:16px}
.card{position:relative;border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);padding:28px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .35s;will-change:transform}
.card:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--lav-2),0 30px 60px -30px rgba(13,20,82,.35)}
.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(380px circle at var(--x,50%) var(--y,50%),rgba(43,63,192,.09),transparent 45%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.card:hover:before{opacity:1}
.card>*{position:relative}
.card .ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:18px;transition:transform .4s}
.card:hover .ic{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1)}
.card h4{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:8px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;max-width:330px}
.card.w2{grid-column:span 2}.card.h2{grid-row:span 2}
.card.lav{background:var(--lav);box-shadow:none}
.card.navy{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--navy-2),var(--navy));box-shadow:none}
.card.navy h4{color:#fff}.card.navy p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.card.navy .ic{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.card.lav .ic{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.card.img{padding:0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;box-shadow:none}
.card.img .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:30% 30%;transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.card.img:hover .bg{transform:scale(1.07)}
.card.img:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(13,20,82,.88),rgba(13,20,82,0) 55%)}
.card.img .cnt{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:28px}
.card.img h4{color:#fff;font-size:34px}
.card.img p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.card.img .tags{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
.card.img .tags span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:#fff;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px}
.rings{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:16px}
.rings div{text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}
.rings svg{width:64px;height:64px;margin-bottom:6px}
.rings circle{fill:none;stroke-width:6}
.rings .bg{stroke:#e6e8f2}
.rings .fg{stroke:var(--navy);stroke-linecap:round;transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:center;stroke-dasharray:170;stroke-dashoffset:170;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.in .rings .fg{stroke-dashoffset:var(--o)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.chips span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
.card.navy .chips span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;box-shadow:none}
.chips span.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;box-shadow:none}
.card .mini{position:absolute;right:-20px;bottom:-150px;transform:rotate(-10deg);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.card:hover .mini{transform:rotate(-5deg) translateY(-34px)}
.card .mini .phone{width:190px}
.scanline{position:absolute;right:28px;top:28px;width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:16px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);overflow:hidden}
.scanline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;top:16px;bottom:16px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px,#fff 6px 8px,transparent 8px 12px);opacity:.85}
.scanline:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:#7fe3a1;box-shadow:0 0 12px 2px #7fe3a1;animation:scan 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes scan{0%,100%{top:8%}50%{top:88%}}
.deal{position:absolute;right:24px;top:24px;font-size:30px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--navy);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:8px 14px;transform:rotate(6deg);transition:transform .4s}
.card:hover .deal{transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1.08)}

/* kate */
.kate{position:relative;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:150px 0 170px;overflow:hidden}
.wave{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-1px;height:90px;z-index:1}
.wave svg{width:200%;height:100%;animation:wv 14s linear infinite}
.wave.bot{top:auto;bottom:-1px;transform:scaleY(-1)}
.wave.bot svg{animation-direction:reverse}
.final .wave{z-index:3}
@keyframes wv{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.kate .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.kate .pics{position:relative;height:620px}
.kate .pics>div{position:absolute;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.kate .pics .a{left:0;top:0;width:78%;height:66%}
.kate .pics .b{right:0;bottom:0;width:50%;height:58%;border:6px solid var(--navy)}
.kate .pics img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.kate .pics>div:hover img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.kate .pics .stamp{position:absolute;left:4%;bottom:6%;width:128px;height:128px;z-index:3;animation:spin 18s linear infinite}
.kate .pics .stamp text{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:3.2px;fill:#fff;text-transform:uppercase}
.kate .pics .stampc{position:absolute;left:4%;bottom:6%;width:128px;height:128px;z-index:4;display:grid;place-items:center}
.kate .pics .stampc span{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.kate .pics .stampc img{width:34px}
.kate h2{color:#fff;margin:20px 0 30px}
.kate .pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff}
.kate .pill i{background:var(--sky)}
.kate .voice p{font-size:19px;line-height:1.75;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.kate .voice .gap{height:16px}
.kate .voice strong{color:#fff}
.kate .sig{display:inline-block;margin-top:26px;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;font-style:italic;color:var(--sky);letter-spacing:-.02em}

/* pricing */
.pricing{position:relative;padding:150px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,var(--lav) 25%,var(--lav) 75%,#fff 100%);overflow:hidden}
.pricing .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.pricing .head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:36px}
.pricing .head h2{margin:18px 0 14px}
.switch{display:inline-flex;position:relative;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -16px rgba(13,20,82,.35);margin-bottom:40px}
.switch button{position:relative;z-index:2;border:0;background:none;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);transition:color .3s}
.switch button.on{color:#fff}
.switch button em{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;background:var(--green);color:#fff;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:2px}
.switch .knob{position:absolute;z-index:1;top:6px;bottom:6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--navy);transition:all .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.pcard{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-radius:36px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 50px 100px -50px rgba(13,20,82,.5)}
.pcard .l{position:relative;padding:52px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
